TITLE: Civic Proposal: Install More Pauses
TEXT:
CIVIC PROPOSAL
INSTALL MORE PAUSES

We propose:
- benches every 200 meters
- water fountains near arguments
- public clocks that sometimes read "BREATHE"
- signage reminding drivers: "OTHER PEOPLE HAVE INNER LIVES"

Budget notes:
Pauses cost less than repairs.
Rest costs less than burnout.
Kindness costs less than policing.

Motion:
Adopt immediately.
Seconded by:
anyone who has ever sat down on a curb
and felt grateful for gravity.
